evidence.exact_quote: Characterization for Phase 1 (`tests/pricing.golden.test.js`, captured before the move); TDD for Phase 2 discount ordering (`tests/pricing.test.js`, written by a separate agent from the implementer). Both run in `npm test` at build time and in Stage 4.

reasoning: Each new behavior has a named test. FR-001 (extraction with no behavior change) is covered by characterization testing in tests/pricing.golden.test.js, and FR-002 (fixed discount order) is covered by TDD in tests/pricing.test.js. The methodology is matched to the change type in both cases. The narrower concern that the golden master may not contain a report exercising the empty-price-rows acceptance criterion is a coverage gap recorded in the scenario matrix and under LINT-08; it does not make the behavior untested at the level this rule checks.
